6064629375589548039.title: Novice Mining Pickaxe
6064629375589548039.description: It sings a dull tone when swung with confidence and a flat one when hesitated--more tutor than tool. The rhythm of the mine begins here.

6064629376912654678.title: Goblin Mask
6064629376912654678.description: Carved in haste, but worn with pride by a traveling mummer's troupe, its crooked grin has caused more spilled soup than any sword.

6064629376919863828.title: Sanctus Skulker Gauntlets
6064629376919863828.description: Worn beneath the canopy where shadow and sunlight braid together, these gauntlets steady the grip in uncertain moments. Their touch lingers with the calm of mossed stone.

6064629376946275026.title: Riverstalker Cloak
6064629376946275026.description: Moves against the wind, though never when questioned.

6064629377019413586.title: Verdant Oath Shortbow
6064629377019413586.description: Laced with vine and soft to the grasp, the Verdant Oath Shortbow bends like new growth but holds firm under tension. Its arrows carry the scent of green things and stir petals in flight.

6064630140769206400.title: Novice Armorsmith's Shirt
6064630140769206400.description: Thick-woven and flame-defiant, this shirt stands between you and the hiss of molten metal. Its stitching is tight as a blood pact.

6064630140781920391.title: Journeyman Leatherworker's Tool Belt
6064630140781920391.description: Each buckle bears a faint engraving of the leatherworker's knot--worn smooth by repetition, but never erased. To trace it with your thumb is to remember why you began.

6064630141141319831.title: Apprentice Cook's Skivvies
6064630141141319831.description: Soft but never spill-shy, these kitchen-bound pants are splashed with sauce and pride. Their pockets are deep enough to hide spices, or secrets.

6064630141156262046.title: Novice Animal Husbandrist's Shirt
6064630141156262046.description: Spun to wick sweat and shrug off fur, this shirt works where hands must soothe. Its quiet strength lies in rolled sleeves and always-roomy pockets.

6064630141173891242.title: Apprentice Weaver's Skivvies
6064630141173891242.description: Worn by those pledged to the art of binding color, pattern, and meaning into cloth that remembers more than it shows. Subtle and silent, garments like these are the loom's first whisper.

6064630174274551928.title: Skull of Thunder
6064630174274551928.description: Ancient and brittle minotaur skull. It bears the mark of the minotaur champion, Vultauro the Bull.

sources.name: No bleed, NO BLEED! Take skull. Skull yours. Let live.
Smart you are. Deal is deal.

6064630214427279778.title: Adventurer's Boots
6064630214427279778.description: These boots are stitched together from a single thread, beginning with a single spiral under the heel, like the start of a story.

6064630367571738861.title: Stonebreath Apprentice Pickaxe
6064630367571738861.description: Modeled after the famed mining tool passed to a promising new guild apprentice when its current wielder graduates. Stonebreath never asks for a name--only a promise.

6064630378770595842.title: Greenthorn Vest
6064630378770595842.description: Crafted in a style originated by a chronically tardy hedge mage looking to better himself. Never still, never sated!

6064630407096238082.title: Glutinous Girdle
6064630407096238082.description: It doesn't know the definition of the word moderation, and doesn't care to learn.

6064630417470717960.title: Growler's Severed Head
more: The severed head of a monstrous wolf, its dead eyes forever frozen in a vacant rage, its maw agape in a silent roar. Matted fur is caked with dried blood, and dull yellow fangs, sharp as razors, gleam ominously even in death.

6064630417660968994.description:

sources.name: I need to deliver the Shoddy Granite Ashlar Blocks to a Tradesmanager.

6064631121090248756.title: Pridestrider
6064631121090248756.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: The Pridestrider moves with the solemn grace of a living myth, a mount woven from the breath of storms and the silence of sacred groves. Its head bears the visage of a white lion, regal and unyielding, crowned with a pair of straight, gleaming horns that rise like spears of moonstone toward the heavens. The torso is that of a great gorilla, heavy with primal strength and steady as a mountain?s heart. Its wings, vast and fragile in appearance, unfold in shimmering layers like the breath of a butterfly caught between worlds, scattering iridescent light with each beat. The Pridestrider does not gallop or glide but commands the air with the authority of a sovereign spirit. It answers only to the Mayor of Miraleth, whose dominion must hold the weight of law and the lightness of vision in equal measure.

sources.name: If you must travel that way, I have something which might help you on your journey. When the roads are illuminated, it will ward off monsters for the time being. Light the way for the rest of us, so that we might make it through the night unharmed.
If you see anything odd or suspicious, make a note of it and I'll include it in my report.
Remind the townspeople and local residents that it's past their bedtime. If you run into any of them, just send them home for me. It's too risky in this neck of the woods to walk about unfettered.

6064631958865051655.title: Daffodil Blooms
6064631958865051655.description:
A crate of tightly packed daffodils. They're stored bloom up, atop a damp bolt of cloth no doubt meant to keep them fresh.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Crate of Succulent Fruit

A crate of various local fruits of the sort used to make ciders.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Flower Bulbs

A crate tightly packed with the bulbs of some local flower, the spaces between loosely filled with soil. Apparently, they're all the rage outside of the riverlands.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Floral Essences

A crate full of corked earthenware jars. Each one smells strongly of local flowers.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Case of Pressed Flower Petals

A crate full of pressed flower petals; much lighter than you'd think.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Case of Crystalized Honey

The honey stored in this case has bene dried out, forming amber-like chunks that are hard as glass. Apparently distillers use them in their mash.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064632746291953664.title: Ancient Dunzen Ingot
6064632746291953664.description:
Drop: Forgelord Zammer 
Ingredient In: Jeweler, Weaponsmithing
more: The forging techniques and alloys produced by Dunzen forges were exceptional; more of their recipes and techniques for alloying Verran metals have been lost than remain today. This ingot, crusted with time, is probably one of the last remaining of its particular quality.

6064632746560651305.title: Pinion Pen
6064632746560651305.description: The administrators that the Toren empire sent to Braithreach could deliver more death and suffering with a stroke of their pens than any of the Forgeguards bloodiest whims.

6064632746585292999.title: Forgeguard's Deflector

6064632752353640465.title: Harrowed Stars Focus
6064632752353640465.description: A focus weapon encrusted with seven different precious stones, each one representing one of the gods, commissioned in bygone times by temple guards at the Church of the Seven Stars. Though it was a sanctuary for hundreds of years, the apocalypse turned the temple into an abattoir.

6064633271688167472.description: A paired set of rusty wood-handled knives. Each identical blade is about the length of your hand, and would be equally suited to carving up a grem or a goblin.

6064633272386125831.title: Ashbrand Root-Dagger
6064633272386125831.description: There are grooves in the grip no hand remembers carving. It always points home, though no one agrees where that is.

6064633289838428641.title: Doomthunder
6064633289838428641.description: Ordin was rumored to be a gladiator in the wastelands, simply to test his mettle. Known for wielding his unique warmaul, he went on to join the Seahammer Maulers to battle sea giants and pirates.

6064633419687133199.title: Journeyman Tempering Kit - Weapon
6064633419687133199.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633430594552987.title: Spindlesilk
6064633430594552987.description:
Drop: Viirmythus the Spider Queen

6064633430598812834.title: Heart of the Abyss
6064633430598812834.description:
Drop: Echo of Atrax 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: These stones, harvested from the abyssal plains of the far seas, are a form of Shoal Cinder that fell to the sea floor in ages long lost. A full dozen graced the original Mirror Helm.

6064633447418757120.title: Bloomthorn Blades
6064633447418757120.description: Every bloom has its blade. The thorns of corrupted flora often prove to be effective as makeshift daggers. Some artisans have even crafted superior blades from the thorns of plantoids.

6064633447851557098.title: Iron Wing Breastplate
6064633447851557098.description: The mystic bond between the force of nature and the spirit of the Iron Wing warriors is held fast by the Shrill Master, a shaman whose shrill calls evoke bravery in all Kreeok hearts.

6064633584072916992.title: Case of Suncrystal Sand
6064633584072916992.description:
Fine, shimmering sand with rare crystal particles found only in the heart of the Sandsquall dunes. Often used to create eccentric glassware.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Crate of Dustleaf Tea

Dried leaves from the hardy dustleaf bush, known to thrive on morning dew. Its tea has invigorating and detoxifying effects.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Barrel of Sunscorched Venom

Extracted from desert scorpions that can be diluted into medicine for pain relief and fever.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate Silk Bedrolls

Layered textile mats and padded silk rolls used by desert travelers. Commonly used by desert nomads due to its light nature in the blistering sun.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Moonshade Figs

A nocturnal fruit that ripens only under full moonlight and extreme temperature shifts. Sweet with a slight spice, and extremely rare.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

Test crate for carrying.  Reduces movement speed while held.

6064633780630847488.description: Worn leather, scorched edges, its rune-stamped cover. Faded ink whispers of elemental lore-obsession hand-etched into every brittle page.

6064633787024408576.title: Ruby-Scaled Fish
6064633787024408576.description: A fish formed of ruby scales. It's workmanship is exquisite, as its tailfin wiggles in hopes of some form of locomotion. It's very brittle and feels like it could disintegrate in your fingers.

6064633820973760515.description:
Crate if goods, packed by you, and pack muled by you.

6064633860905959429.title: Stonechant Mantle
6064633860905959429.description: Tight across the shoulders as if bearing the weight of memory unspoken.

6064633860906680335.title: Thornway Accord Grips
6064633860906680335.description: Holds firm even through hesitation, as though guided by a vow the hand forgot.

6064633860907139097.title: Oathdelve Sash
6064633860907139097.description: Cinches during moments of hesitation, as if reminding the wearer who they were.

6064633860908646444.title: Hallowmark Cowl
6064633860908646444.description: Shadows curve unnaturally across it, avoiding the crown of the brow.

6064633860909367341.title: Suncleft Choir Cape
6064633860909367341.description: Threaded with discipline and echo, this cape once stirred in rhythm with the chimes of the buried shrines. It carries the hush of reverence, as if worn by one expected to listen before they speak.

6064633860909367348.title: Suncleft Choir Belt
6064633860909367348.description: Said to follow the breath of the wearer, this belt holds firm not by force, but by the unseen rhythm carried within every sacred hymn.

6064633860910350397.title: Starlight Creed Girdle
6064633860910350397.description: Woven to hold more than weight, this girdle cinches the will with silent precision. Mariners once fasted before donning it, whispering promises into the seafoam.

6064633860916248734.title: Brinetread Shoulders
6064633860916248734.description: Curve to turn aside the strike and shed the spray, their low weight keeping the arms unburdened.

6064633860916773033.title: Gritmantle Belt
6064633860916773033.description: Secures the set in a tight, unmoving fit, the straps drawn as firmly as a gate bar set against the night.

6064633860917166254.title: Veilrender Greaves
6064633860917166254.description: Fitted snug to the shin, each piece beveled to slip through bracken without catching, polished only enough to shed the rain.

6064633860918411459.title: Slagwalker Gauntlets
6064633860918411459.description: Close-fitting and jointed for deft motion, still holding the dark stain of long days spent in smoke and spark.

6064633860918739145.title: Wavebound Greaves
6064633860918739145.description: Shaped to follow the pull of the calf, their lower edge flared slightly to turn aside surf and running water.

6064633860918739147.title: Wavebound Pauldrons
6064633860918739147.description: Swept outward in a layered fan, each plate overlaps the next like the scales of a great fish, ready to meet the rush of wave or blade.

6064633860919066836.title: Dunecoil Shoulders
6064633860919066836.description: Curve low and broad, their weight balanced to give protection without slowing the turn of the body.

6064633860919525596.title: Gloomraider Bracers
6064633860919525596.description: Hold the forearms in a firm guard, turning aside the blow while leaving the hands free for weapon or rope.

6064633860920574186.title: Coalhewn Cape
6064633860920574186.description: Falls in dark, heavy folds that bear the quiet weight of the deep, its edges marked faintly as though dusted by the soot of a forge long at work.

6064633860920574190.title: Coalhewn Bracers
6064633860920574190.description: Rest firm on the forearms, their matte surface catching only the faintest glint of light from a passing ember.

6064633860921229568.title: Scorchmantle Bracers
6064633860921229568.description: Bound tight against the forearm, their outer ridges show the ripple of metal stressed by many seasons of heat and sudden chill.

6064633860921491725.title: Duskhunter Helm
6064633860921491725.description: Shadows the eyes beneath a low rim, narrowing the view to what matters while keeping the mind clear in the oppressive dark.

6064633860947509550.title: Glenwarden Helm
6064633860947509550.description: The helm's sloped crown and flared cheekguards mimic the silhouette of a glen sentinel?s hood. The eye slits are narrow but deep, perfect for catching the glint of a moving shadow.

6064633860948820290.description: Shoulder guards covered in curled leafmail, heavy with dewlight. They sway slightly when no wind blows.

6064633860950917460.title: Luminous Concord Spaulders
6064633860950917460.description: Broad and deliberate in design, these spaulders carry the memory of resolve held firm through fire. Each edge seems shaped to turn both blade and doubt aside.

6064633860971561306.title: Stormcanon Gages
6064633860971561306.description: Salt-tempered and wave-worn, these gages hold fast through impact and upheaval. Their knuckleplates ring faintly when struck, as if echoing the pulse of distant drums beneath the surf.

6064633860983357856.title: Moltruin Sabatons
6064633860983357856.description: Their tread lands with the heaviness of cooled lava, the weight sinking into the ground as if it remembers the slow crawl of molten stone.

6064633860983357861.title: Moltruin Pauldrons
6064633860983357861.description: Rise like the jagged edges of a caldera, standing as both shield and sign of the power held within.

6064633860983685543.title: Brineplate Cape
6064633860983685543.description: Trailing in the wind like the proud wake of a ship that has weathered a hundred storms, it bears the scent of distant squalls and the low murmur of the deep, as if the ocean itself moves to shield the bearer's back.

6064633860983947696.title: Sunbastion Cape
6064633860983947696.description: Spreads behind the wearer like the shade cast by a high desert wall at noon, carrying the rare coolness that endures in places built to outlast the sun.

6064633860984275392.title: Graveplate Pauldrons
6064633860984275392.description: Rise from the shoulders like the moss-covered spires of crypts long reclaimed, their presence a warning to whatever watches from the undergrowth.

6064633860985061828.title: Ironwake Boots
6064633860985061828.description: Plant each stride as though setting a foundation stone, the weight carried evenly through every pace.

6064633860985717198.title: Coralhold Bracers
6064633860985717198.description: Their clasp recalls the firm anchor of reef to seabed, lending the arms the same poise and precision as a hunter poised within the coral maze.

6064633860985717201.title: Coralhold Greaves
6064633860985717201.description: Bear the patient strength of tideworn stone, guiding each stride with the measure of the sea's own steady advance.

6064633860987486703.title: Anvilguard Cape
6064633860987486703.description: It sweeps behind like the shadow of a high wall at sunset, carrying the still air of mountain strongholds where no enemy foot has ever fallen.

6064633860988666371.title: Sandbastion Boots
6064633860988666371.description: Step lightly over dune and rock, finding their balance in the shifting ground as though the sands themselves give way in deference.

6064633860988666373.title: Sandbastion Gauntlets
6064633860988666373.description: Grip with the certainty of stone in the hand of a builder, ready to hold fast or to drive forward as the moment demands.

6064633860989321739.title: Tombplate Cuirass
6064633860989321739.description: Encases the chest in a carapace of vigilance, each plate a ward set against the slow, patient threats that move beneath the canopy and within the stone.

6064633860989321745.title: Tombplate Pauldrons
6064633860989321745.description: Rise from the shoulders like the heavy lintels of an ancient gate, bearing the unseen pressure of ages.

6064633860997710358.title: Emberwake Sash
6064633860997710358.description: Pulls taut before speech, as if it braces for what must be said

6064633860998562343.title: Runebreath Mantle
6064633860998562343.description: Flares briefly at the name of certain stars, then stills without apology.

6064633860999086640.title: Ashwoke Mantle
6064633860999086640.description: Ashen pauldrons made from cracked scale and bone-char. They settle like dust, unnoticed until the wind shifts.

6064633860999479870.title: Candlefen Grips
6064633860999479870.description: The hands go cold inside them, but the cold is not unwelcome.

6064633861010162330.title: Seafoam Hood
6064633861010162330.description: Falls low to shade the eyes from the sun's glare, letting the gaze remain fixed on the horizon without strain.

6064633861010424484.title: Dustwhisper Leggings
6064633861010424484.description: Flow with each step like wind over a dune's crest, moving freely whether in a low crouch or a full sprint.

6064633861010424486.title: Dustwhisper Sash
6064633861010424486.description: Binds the set together with a quiet knot, its loose ends drifting as lightly as sand on a warm breeze.

6064633861010752177.title: Shadeweft Boots
6064633861010752177.description: Step softly over damp loam and tangled root, their tread leaving no trace for those who follow.

6064633861012062904.title: Thistledown Sash
6064633861012062904.description: Ties the set together with an easy knot, the ends fluttering lightly in the wind as the wearer moves.

6064633861012259524.title: Glimmersoot Bracers
6064633861012259524.description: Wrap the forearms in a light guard, their surface catching the faint sheen of heated iron as though touched by the forge itself.

6064633861012521678.title: Mistglean Hands
6064633861012521678.description: Fit with a sailor's precision, each grip holding firm even when the salt wind slicks the fingers.

6064633861012718289.title: Veilsand Leggings
6064633861012718289.description: Move easily through long strides, their fabric loose enough for air to pass while close enough not to catch the wind.

6064633861012980449.title: Wraithskin Cape
6064633861012980449.description: Hangs in thin, tattered folds that ripple like shadow passing over stone, its movement so slight it seems more imagined than seen.

6064633861013832424.title: Brightgrove Bracers
6064633861013832424.description: Fasten around the arms with the firm hold of bark on the trunk, lending stability whether the hands are raised in defense or mid-swing.

6064633861013832426.title: Brightgrove Cape
6064633861013832426.description: Falls in soft, leaf-shadowed folds that break the outline of the wearer, letting them blend into the shifting light beneath the canopy.

6064633861014029038.title: Ashveil Sash
6064633861014029038.description: Binds the layers together in a single, balanced hold, the knot kept tight and silent against the side.

6064633861014553345.title: Duneflare Jerkin
6064633861014553345.description: Cut for ease in the heat, its light layers breathe with the wind that rolls off the dunes, giving the wearer freedom to move at a moment's call.

6064633861014881034.title: Nightwhisper Jerkin
6064633861014881034.description: Worn close for freedom of movement, its light layers shift with the body so each motion is swallowed by the stillness around it.

6064633861014881036.title: Nightwhisper Bracers
6064633861014881036.description: Lie smooth against the forearms, offering just enough guard to turn a strike without catching the eye.

6064633866775822364.title: Glimmerbound Necklace
6064633866775822364.description: Woven from glint-thread and relic wire, this piece once circled the throat of the Thragdul Choir's principle chorus-weilder. Its shimmer aligns with breath and will, quickening the space between thought and command.

6064633866784014397.title: Foamcast Necklace
6064633866784014397.description: Cast in the sweep of a rising wave, it keeps a pearly gleam, the hush of far surf living quiet within its curve.

6064633866788470855.title: Wavedtossed Earring
6064633866788470855.description: A slim curl shaped like the crest of a breaker, its surface holds the soft sheen of water at dawn, brightening when turned toward the open horizon.

6064633866956439637.title: Thornbound Axe
6064633866956439637.description: Wrapped in memories of overgrowth and stone, this axe hums with restraint. It is heavy where it must be, and light where it cuts.

6064633867093278858.title: Glorybound Great Axe
6064633867093278858.description: Ceremonial lines meet fieldwise balance, a guardian's blade that carries the weight of vows kept.

6064633867109793946.title: Coralblade Codex
6064633867109793946.description: Spined like reefbone and sealed with brine, this tome bears the scent of open water and the hush of deep trenches.

6064633867115561129.title: Nightreaver Great Grimoire
6064633867115561129.description: Ink dries to a matte hush that swallows stray glints, leaving only the path of the words in the gloom.

6064633867118969006.title: Ironhearth Dagger
6064633867118969006.description: Short, weighty, and without pretense, the Ironhearth Dagger is forged for utility rather than elegance. It strikes clean through cloth or chain and leaves behind a scent like hot stone after rain.

6064633867120738482.title: Coralblade Dagger
6064633867120738482.description: The edge catches moonlight like foam on black water. It smells faintly of salt and regret.

6064633867180245214.title: Glassveil Focus
6064633867180245214.description: Translucent planes shift with light, echoing the still clarity of desert glass.

6064633867182342369.title: Mistwood Longbow
6064633867182342369.description: Light in the hand and silent in release, the Mistwood Longbow blends into foliage even when strung. Dew gathers along the curve at dawn, and birds do not startle when it fires.

6064633867188502773.title: Stormcurrent Longbow
6064633867188502773.description: Cool to the touch, its arc shaped to channel unseen pull and flow.

6064633867246240113.title: Stoneforge Shield
6064633867246240113.description: Flat-faced and rimmed in steel, the Stoneforge Shield feels heavier when held without purpose. It never rattles when struck, and dust never settles on its surface for long.

6064633867246567794.title: Runeweld Shield
6064633867246567794.description: Marked with old wards and rimmed in faint glyphs, the Runeweld Shield holds firm against spell and strike alike. Its face grows cool near hidden doors and warmer when secrets are spoken.

6064633867247354228.title: Sandcarved Shield
6064633867247354228.description: Etched by scouring winds and sun-born rites, this shield bears no crest but the memory of distant ruin. Its surface whispers of caravans lost and secrets kept in heat-shattered silence.

6064633867251024257.title: Mirageborn Shield
6064633867251024257.description: Contours seem to waver in heat shimmer, then return to true angles as the grip tightens.

6064633867252662662.title: Dreadwake Shield
6064633867252662662.description: River dark and low gloss, its rim bears the soft rounding of metal long kept in damp places.

6064633867262296479.title: Ironhearth Spear
6064633867262296479.description: Rigid and evenly weighted, the Ironhearth Spear carries the feel of a forged oath. It drives straight even through wind, and the shaft vibrates faintly when held over bare stone.

6064633867264065955.title: Coralblade Spear
6064633867264065955.description: Barbed with the sharp symmetry of reef-born ruin, its thrust stirs the ghosts of sunken sanctums.

6064633867279860179.title: Wavecutter Sword
6064633867279860179.description: Its edge glides as though the air itself were water, parting in perfect silence. The steel bears the faint scent of deep tides and distant horizons.

6064633867281105368.title: Glassveil Sword
6064633867281105368.description: The surface bends light in soft waves, mirroring the shifting air over the Sandsquall horizon.

6064633867283988957.title: Runeweld Greatsword
6064633867283988957.description: Broad and etched with forgotten language, the Runeweld Greatsword hums when lifted with purpose. Its weight shifts ever so slightly, aligning with the path carved in thought.

6064633867295392259.title: Wavecutter Wand
6064633867295392259.description: Its shape flows like water past a keen blade. The scent of open seas clings to it.

6064633895608778759.title: Costume Cosmetic: Remnant Sympathizer
6064633895608778759.description:
Costume Cosmetic
This cosmetic will override the visual look of your armor when you equip it.

6064633895609827336.title: Mount Cosmetic: Daystrider
6064633895609827336.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Towering and odd-looking, the Daystrider is a beast unlike any other. First discovered by a Kaelar mining crew in the mountains, this strange quadruped?s spindly legs and elongated face left quite an impression. Its peculiar snout allows it to root out insects from high cliff walls, and it remains remarkably stable even on treacherous terrain. Horses often falter in Verra?s more rugged regions, but the Daystrider glides over them with ease. Despite its intimidating height, the creature proved gentle and easy to train. Once coaxed with handfuls of insects, it was even rideable. It can carry large loads, traverse unstable ground, and move surprisingly fast when motivated by food. This bizarre yet capable mount has since become a beloved companion to adventurers willing to look past its unusual silhouette.

6064633895609958409.title: Mount Cosmetic: Stuffertons
6064633895609958409.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Patchy, plush, and filled with charm, Stuffertons is a mount stitched from magic and whimsy. Beloved by children and the young at heart, it moves with surprising grace, carrying its rider in cuddly style across any terrain. Its button eyes may not blink, but many swear they twinkle.

6064633895616380940.title: Mount Cosmetic: Pridestalker
6064633895616380940.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Sleek, territorial, and relentless, the Pridestalker is no mere beast of burden. Its sinuous body moves with deadly grace, gliding between the trees like a shadow with claws. Though it tolerates no rival and submits to no master, a rare few have forged bonds with this apex predator. As a mount, it is swift, silent, and unshakable, bearing only those brave enough to ride beside death itself.

6064633895622606865.title: Mount Cosmetic: Bonestrider
6064633895622606865.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Wreathed in cold flame and pieced together by necromantic will, the Bonestrider is more specter than steed. It bears no flesh, no voice, only the ceaseless rattle of motion and the eerie trail of blue fire in its wake. Once loyal in life, now bound in death, it marches without pause beneath those bold or foolish enough to mount it.

6064633895716126785.title: Mount Cosmetic: Whispering Watcher
6064633895716126785.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Silent and spectral, the Whispering Watcher glides through forest and fog with otherworldly grace. Riders speak of hearing faint whispers in the breeze as it walks, a soft chorus of unseen voices. Used as a mount by those who value secrecy and stillness, it is both guardian and guide through the wildwood.

6064633895729102923.title: Mount Cosmetic: Fox of the Pyre
6064633895729102923.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Wreathed in flickering embers and trailing smoke with every step, the Fox of the Pyre moves like a flame given form. Legends claim it was born in sacred fire, a guardian spirit tasked with protecting ancient rites and forgotten altars. Its eyes glow with steady heat, and its paws leave no prints, only scorched whispers on the ground. Elusive yet unmistakable, it is drawn to those who walk the line between light and shadow and who carry purpose like a spark waiting to catch.

6064633900614418512.title: Ironhearth Threadpiercer
6064633900614418512.description: The Ironhearth Threadpiercer quivers when truths are tested and slips through gaps too narrow for steel. It leaves no wound at first, only a delayed ache that deepens with silence.

6064633900614942802.title: Mistwood Thornpoint
6064633900614942802.description: The Mistwood Thornpoint draws hairline cuts that bloom late and without pain. Its presence unsettles birds and dims lanterns by a single wick.

6064633900617760860.title: Stoneforge Edgemind
6064633900617760860.description: The Stoneforge Edgemind adjusts its balance subtly with every step, always seeming ready before the wielder is. Its tip leaves faint scoring in the air, visible only when no one is speaking.

6064633900649349227.title: Dreadwake Undertow Great Mace
6064633900649349227.description: On the rise and fall it carries a hush like a current below sight.

6064633900659703942.title: Wavecutter Tidesurge Great Mace
6064633900659703942.description: The sweeping head seems to lean forward, its edges shaped to follow the rush of water.

6064633900693323932.title: Seabright Tideforged Spear
6064633900693323932.description: Hints of deep blue flicker within the metal, recalling waters where light rarely falls.

6064633900727664828.title: Deepweld Ember Twin Daggers
6064633900727664828.description: Faint heat lines drift the steel, a kiln soft glow that lingers along the spine when they move.

6064633900727926973.title: Deepweld Stonegrip Focus
6064633900727926973.description: Roughset grip and steady heft lend the weight of quarried rock to the hold.

6064633900785271006.title: Glassveil Sunshard Longbow
6064633900785271006.description: Each limb glows faintly when turned toward the open sky.

6064633900823281909.title: Mistwood Channelstone
6064633900823281909.description: The Mistwood Channelstone clouds slightly when danger is near, though it clears the moment doubt enters the mind. When whispered to, it sometimes whispers back.

6064634489919111168.title: The Arrow That Never Was
6064634489919111168.description: Strung with silence and shaped like a question unasked, this bow is longer than the arm can reach, and yet it draws without resistance. Along the limbs are impressions of vanished arrows, each a phantom trajectory burned into the air. Its surface is worn smooth by vanished hands, and the grip is polished by intent long severed from action. Those who draw it find themselves staring not at a target, but into a space where choices once were.

6064634597712658438.title: Sliver of Qtorum
6064634597712658438.description: Slender as a truth half-swallowed, this blade was once a ritual scribe?s stylus ? reforged in the shadow of its twin. Its edge is honed not by steel but by contradiction, and it slips past armor as easily as hesitation into a prophet?s heart. The pommel is bound with desert twine, looped in deliberate imperfection, forming a broken hourglass that never runs out.

6064634618889830460.title: Miner's Skivvies

6064634618895663167.title: Lumberjack's Shirt
6064634618895663167.description: Stitched from oxcloth and dyed in crushed alder bark, this shirt carries the scent of green wood and wet earth. Its sleeves roll high, and its cuffs fray early--both signs that it's being used correctly.

6064634761950855177.title: Shatterhill Midband
6064634761950855177.description: Taken from Balgruc?s tomb court, this heavy belt bears the weight of buried rank. Its worn sigils tighten resolve like a clenched oath, reminding the wearer that even in death, duty holds fast.

6064634762011869253.title: Kilnwarden's Knell
6064634762011869253.description: Once a hall keeper?s baton, now a bandit captain?s verdict, this mace carries the echo of order turned sour. The head is etched with rebuke rites meant to steady crowds and shame oathbreakers, ringing in the hand like a stern bell.

6064634762013835338.title: Talonscar Vambraces
6064634762013835338.description: Notched for narrow escapes at the Nesting Ground, this bracer hums with predatory tempo. It steadies the forearm like a warning drumbeat, urging swift strikes, sharp turns, and clean retreat, without fear.

6064634762107682906.title: Runeblast Vigil Mantle
6064634762107682906.description: This light shoulder guard was kept by sentries who watched the Divide for signs in the stone. Its faint glyphs do not shout, they warn, tightening the senses when the land feels wrong, and easing only when the horizon clears.

6064634766102822912.title: The Hourglass Remnant
6064634766102822912.description:
On Damage Dealt: 10% chance to apply a curse to your target, dealing 100% physical power as necrotic damage, and reducing healing received by 15%
Duration: 15 seconds
Cooldown: 30 seconds

Weapon cannot be repaired
more: This sword was forged in the days before the Divide, when Qluud still walked beside his twin. It was never raised in war, only carried in rites of accord and judgement. The blade bears no mark of conquest, only the silence left by separation. Its purpose was not to kill, but to decide.
